verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and crawling API, so sticky proxy sessions are a fair axis for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents proxy control, session identifiers, or keeping the same IP across requests. Community posts only ask whether it uses residential or rotating proxies, which is not evidence either way.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity
